evals.prompt: Review my presentation at test_presentation.pptx and suggest ways to make the text more concise and professional. Add your suggestions as PowerPoint comments.
evals.expected_output: The original pptx is overwritten with modern PowerPoint comments anchored to specific text ranges on the relevant slides. Comments contain suggested replacement text.

evals.prompt: Look at slides 2 and 3 of test_presentation.pptx. The audience is C-suite executives. Suggest changes that add specific metrics and make the language more impactful. Add comments.
evals.expected_output: Comments are only added to slides 2 and 3. Suggestions are executive-friendly with concrete metrics. No comments on slide 1.

evals.prompt: I've replied to your comments in test_presentation_replies.pptx. Read my feedback and respond with revised suggestions.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads user replies, understands the feedback, and adds reply responses to the comment threads with revised suggestions.
